integrity.external_validation: No independent mathematical audit or validation performed.
integrity.proof_scope: Geometric line classification is proved algebraically over the algebraic closure; finite incidence configuration is exhaustively checked over the field of four elements.
integrity.reproducibility: Run python3 verify_12node_lines.py using the Python standard library.

scientific_limitations: The line scheme is classified only after taking reduced structure; its embedded infinitesimal structure is not determined.
The result is specific to the fixed symmetric quartic over the prime field, not the whole twelve-node family.
The singularity classification of the twelve nodes is known and is not claimed as an original result.
Unindexed classical literature may contain equivalent line and incidence classifications.
title: Twenty lines on a twelve-nodal symmetric quartic in characteristic two
